Analysis: The customer is stranded on the highway shoulder right now (roadside_assistance), and also contests a charge of $1,644 versus the agreed diagnostic fee (billing_dispute). The tie-break says a car stuck right now goes to roadside_assistance unless the customer reports that a repair we did caused the breakdown or demands a manager. Here the customer doesn't say a repair caused the breakdown, so the main type is roadside_assistance. Escalation is safety, since every roadside_assistance request is escalated. The billing dispute goes in secondary_types.
